Characters.Name: Penny
Dialouge1: Hello
I've been feeling kinda down.
Can you help with that?
Do you have what I want?
DialougeSuccess: This is perfect for my groove!
Thank you, I'm feeling much better!
DialougeFail: I'm not quite sure that's making me feel better...

Characters.Name: Liz
Dialouge1: Hey, I'm Liz
I heard you washed up on the shore here. We don't see many 3D people here so please excuse our shock.
Welcome to our little village. Unfortunately, our craftsman went on a trip and hasn't come back.
I was planning on going on an adventure but I couldn't possibly leave now.
Can you help us out? There's not many of us around, only about six others.
When you're done, come by and if you have a way off the island, I can show you to the way back to the 3D world.
Do you have what I want?
DialougeSuccess: I'll prepare it for our journey
If everyone's okay, we'll get going.
DialougeFail: I don't think I'd know how we'd leave with that.
Come back with a way to leave.

Characters.Name: Karen
Dialouge1: Hi sweetheart.
I don't know what is up with the island recently but everyone has been so unfashionable.
Maybe you could replace some of my old wardrobe... I did just buy a new shirt though...
Do you have what I want?
DialougeFail: I don't love those, sorry sweetie.

Characters.Name: Jett
Dialouge1: Hi!!
I found a kitty!
Fred was trying to help me shake the tree.
I don't think Fred was much help though.
Do you have what I want?
DialougeSuccess: This is perfect for the kitty!
DialougeFail: I'm not quite sure the kitty would like that...

Characters.Name: Olive
Dialouge1: Oh, hey there.
You look a little weird...
I like your vibe though. I'd like to look like you. We don't have many people who sew cool clothes around here.
Do you have what I want?
DialougeSuccess: This is perfect! Now I'll be the coolest guy on the island.
Thanks man, I'll see you around.
DialougeFail: Can I have something like you?

Characters.Name: Donna
Dialouge1: Hey!
I hope you're enjoying your visit on this island. Be careful of the thiefs though...
I do wish I could spruce things up around here.
Maybe you have an idea of something that would help.
Do you have what I want?
DialougeSuccess: Oh! yes! This is exactly it! I will have so much fun planting the garden.
Thank you, dear. I hope you'll come visit when it blooms.
DialougeFail: I don't know how I feel about that.

Characters.Name: Fred
Dialouge1: Oh, hi there.
Sorry about how I look right now.
I slipped while trying to get that cat, now I'm covered in mud.
I've heard mud is good for your skin but I feel quite gross right now.
Do you have what I want?
DialougeSuccess: This will help get the mud off my clothes. I'll head home soon to change.
DialougeFail: I'm not in the mood for that.
